hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress, elevated institutional advisory risk, and generally modest or negative composites warrant defensive sizing. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal but remains vulnerable to the stress regime. ETH and SOL longs are fragile because of negative alpha, elevated beta/volatility, and weaker institutional support. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have negative composites and weak or adverse liquidity/institutional factors. ETC is especially fragile: the zero price and zeroed risk/liquidity fields indicate a data-quality or tradability issue, so its long signal should not be trusted.
